recipes.name: Bekki’s Taco Egg Rolls
ingredients_raw: 1 (1 pound) loaf processed cheese food (i.e. Velveeta®), cut into 1/4 inch thick slices

steps.text: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef; cook and crumble until evenly browned and no longer pink. Drain excess grease. Reduce heat to medium. Add onion, garlic, and bell pepper; cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in taco seasoning and taco sauce; cook until the sauce begins to bubble, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and cool for 15 minutes.

Working on a clean, flat surface, place 1 egg roll wrapper with a corner facing you. Spoon about 2 tablespoons beef mixture just below the center and top with 1 strip cheese. Fold the bottom corner over the filling, fold in both side corners, and roll tightly. Brush the final corner with egg white and press to seal.
Place the wrapped roll seam-side down on a second wrapper. Fold and roll it in the same way, then seal the final corner with egg white. Set seam-side down while assembling the remaining egg rolls.
If needed, preheat the oven to 200 degrees F (95 degrees C). Set a wire rack inside a rimmed baking sheet for keeping finished egg rolls warm.

Heat canola oil in a large wok or deep, heavy pot over medium-high heat to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Fry 2 to 3 egg rolls at a time, without crowding, until crisp and golden brown on all sides. Transfer to the wire rack. Keep warm in the oven while frying the remaining rolls, if needed.

raw_recipe.headline: Bekki’s Taco Egg Rolls
raw_recipe.description: Crispy egg rolls are double-wrapped around a cheesy, taco-seasoned beef filling and work well as an appetizer, party snack, or main dish.

review.reviewBody: This was an awesome recipe. My husband loved them. There was extra so the next day I warmed them up with just a pan, no oil and they got crispy again.

Only 4 stars simple because I used skirt steak strips, Mexican cheese & chopped roasted poblano peppers. I also just wet my fingers with water and these were Fast n Easy! I heated up a bit of lard, these were done in no time at all. Love these!

This is a great recipe as a starter recipe but it is recipe for empanadas and she is using egg roll wrappers which depending where you live may be easier to find. Sub out the velveeta for real cheddar cheese and it is very good. Get rid of cooking ground beef with oil and only use 1/2 pkge of taco mix or make your own.
